channel.title: News Releases - U.S. Dept. of War
channel.description: Stay up to date on the latest Department of War statements and announcements.

item.title: Department of War Redesignates CDAO as Super Intelligence Office
item.description: The War Department announced the official redesignation of the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office as the Department of War Super Intelligence Office.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth Elevates Special Operations Leadership to Revitalize the Legacy of the Office of Strategic Services
item.description: Marking a historic shift in the civilian oversight of our nation's elite forces, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth issued a memorandum to elevate the assistant secretary of war for special operations and low-intensity conflict to equal footing with the military department secretaries.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Expands Community-Based Childcare Fee Assistance
item.description: The War Department remains focused on building and maintaining a ready, lethal fighting force prepared to dominate the battlefield and achieve peace through strength.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Poland's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defense Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Poland's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defense Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz at the Pentagon.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: The Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $150 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With Rocket Lab
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Rocket Lab USA Inc. to support Rocket Lab's efforts to increase the flight rate of its reusable Neutron rocket beyond first launch to meet growing commercial and national security demand for ac
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth Orders Sweeping Overhaul of Military Education to Refocus on Combat Lethality
item.description: In a major move to restore a culture of accountability and warfighting excellence, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth directed the comprehensive overhaul of the Department's Professional Military Education system.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Trump Administration Deepens Interagency Collaboration to Protect the Nation's Skies From Unmanned Threats
item.description: The War Department, Department of Transportation, Department of Homeland Security, Department of Energy and Department of Justice announced an expanded interagency effort to further coordinate counter-unmanned aircraft systems operations.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Deputy Assistant Secretary of War Michael DiMino Travels to Bahrain for the 22nd Manama Dialogue
item.description: Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Near East and Central Asia Michael P. DiMino IV attended the International Institute for Strategic Studies' Manama Dialogue in Bahrain.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $75 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With Halo Industries, Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $75 million conditional loan commitment with Halo Industries Inc. to scale production of its innovative Silicon Carbide semiconductor wafers.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $250 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With 6K Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $250 million conditional loan commitment with 6K Inc. to scale the company's domestic production of Nickel-Manganese-Cobalt cathode active material in Jackson, Tenn.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Advanced Radar Contract Bolsters USCENTCOM Counter-UAS Defense
item.description: The War Department's Joint Interagency Task Force 401 awarded a contract valued at more than $6.9 million to CHAOS 1 Inc. for Vanquish Prime advanced radar systems to strengthen counter-unmanned aircraft systems protection for U.S. forces.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: DRPM-UxS Deliver Over 25,000 Autonomous and Counter-Unmanned Systems to CENTCOM AOR
item.description: The War Department announced the Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Unmanned Systems delivered a massive surge of combat-ready, mass-producible unmanned systems and counter-drone capabilities to U.S. Central Command.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $150 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With LeoLabs, Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with LeoLabs Inc., a leading provider of Space Domain Awareness and Space Traffic Management solutions.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of November 2026 U.S.-China Crisis Communications and Prevention Working Group
item.description: The U.S. and China agreed on the importance of advancing practical communication measures to reduce the risks between the two countries during a Crisis Communications and Prevention Working Group meeting.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs Conditional Loan Commitment of up to $450 Million With Neros, Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a conditional loan commitment of up to $450 million to Neros Inc., a U.S.-based developer and manufacturer of dual-use small unmanned aircraft systems.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Releases Fiscal Year 2026 Military Intelligence Program Budget
item.description: The War Department released the Military Intelligence Program appropriated top-line budget for fiscal year 2026. The total was $30.9 billion and is aligned to the National Defense Strategy.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Announces $150 Million in Awards to Multidisciplinary University Research Teams
item.description: The War Department announced $150 million in awards for basic defense-related research projects as part of the Multidisciplinary University Research Initiative.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Achieves 97.5% Obligation Goal of FY 2026 OBBBA Funding
item.description: The War Department announced that it successfully obligated 97.5% of the historic funds provided by President Donald J. Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill Act prior to the close of Fiscal Year 2026.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Joint Statement on Australia-Japan-Philippines-U.S. Defense Ministers' Meeting
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, Australian Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Defense Richard Marles, Japanese Minister of Defense Koizumi Shinjiro and Philippine Secretary of National Defense Gilberto Teodoro Jr. met at the ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting-Plus and committed to bolster deterrenc
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting Singaporean Minister for Defence, CHAN Chun Sing
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Singaporean Minister for Defense Chan Chun Sing and reaffirmed the strength of the longstanding U.S.-Singapore defense partnership.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Philippine Secretary of National Defense Gilberto Teodoro Jr.
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Philippine Secretary of National Defense Gilberto Teodoro, Jr., discussing progress on security cooperation, alliance modernization, and posture initiatives.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Indian Minister of Defence Rajnath Singh
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth held a bilateral meeting with Indian Minister of Defense Rajnath Singh.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Australian Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Defence Richard Marles
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Australia Deputy Prime Minister Richard Marles met in the Philippines and discussed ongoing initiatives to strengthen defense cooperation and the U.S.-Australia Alliance.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Japanese Minister of Defense Shinjirō Koizumi
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Japan's Minister of Defense Shinjirō Koizumi in the Philippines, where the two leaders reaffirmed the indispensable role of the U.S.-Japan Alliance in preserving peace and stability in the Pacific.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Poland Selected to Host Historic PAC-3 Missile Maintenance Facility, Strengthening Allied Burden-Sharing and Transatlantic Security
item.description: On the margins of the NATO Conference of National Armaments Directors meeting, the United States government, in coordination with Lockheed Martin and European allies, announced Poland as the host nation for the European Patriot Advanced Capability-3 Missile Maintenance Facility.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $150 Million Conditional Loan Commitment with Stoke Space Technologies, Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Stoke Space Technologies, Inc., a U.S.-based space launch company developing fully reusable rockets, to provide low-cost, high-cadence access to orbit.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Joint Statement, USS Colorado (SSN 788) Announced as First Submarine for Submarine Rotational Force – West
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Australian and U.K. counterparts announced the designation of the USS Colorado as the first U.S. Navy Virginia-class fast-attack submarine assigned to Submarine Rotational Force West, beginning in late 2027.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: DoW Announces 2026 Secretary of War Maintenance Awards Winners
item.description: The War Department announced the 2026 winners of the Secretary of War Maintenance Awards, which are presented annually to recognize outstanding achievements in weapon systems and military equipment maintenance.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: DoW, Navy Close on $1.7 Billion Hampton Roads Barracks Project
item.description: The War Department and the Navy announced financial close on Homeport Hampton Roads Phase II, a $1.7 billion initiative to modernize unaccompanied housing for thousands of sailors across the Hampton Roads region.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Publishes Seventh Release of Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Files on WAR.GOV/UFO
item.description: The War Department published the seventh release of declassified and historical Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena files as part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War and Lockheed Martin Finalize Landmark 10-Year F-35 Deal, Securing $7B in Private Investment
item.description: The War Department and Lockheed Martin finalized a landmark 10-year framework agreement to strengthen the F-35 Lightning II Joint Strike Fighter fleet.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Awards Tucson Unified School District a $41 Million Grant for Frank Borman K8 School on Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Arizona
item.description: The War Department awarded Tucson Unified School District a $41.1 million grant as the federal share of a larger $54 million project to construct a new Frank Borman K8 School at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Ariz.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegeth's Meeting With His Excellency Dr. Mohamed Irfaan Ali, the President and Commander-in-Chief of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana
item.description: A readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's meeting with Guyanese President Mohamed Irfaan Ali.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth Directs Establishment of New Air National Guard Special Tactics Squadron in Florida
item.description: To enhance the lethality and readiness of our elite joint force, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth has signed a memo directing the establishment of a new Air National Guard Special Tactics Squadron in Florida.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Project Agincourt Accelerates Autonomous Warfare Command to Drive Battlefield Adaptation at Scale
item.description: Project Agincourt leaders Hon. Owen West and Senior Chief Max Strasiser announced the operational roadmap to establish the Autonomous Warfare Command.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War and BAE Systems Sign Framework Agreement to Surge Counter-Drone Production to 25,000 Precision Interceptors Annually
item.description: The War Department announced that it has reached a framework agreement with BAE Systems to ramp up production of the combat-proven Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Announces Research Security Mitigation Results From Academic Institutions
item.description: The War Department announced the successful completion of its initial research security audits of 30 universities.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $80 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With Antheia, Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced an $80 million conditional loan commitment with Antheia, Inc. to scale the company's domestic production of key starting materials and active pharmaceutical ingredients for generic pharmaceutical drugs.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: DOT, DoW, DHS Join Forces to Protect Southern Border Airspace
item.description: The U.S. Department of Transportation, Department of War and Department of Homeland Security announced a new, coordinated effort to strengthen airspace security along the southern U.S. border through a temporary flight restriction for drones.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With the United Kingdom's Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth held a bilateral meeting with the U.K. Secretary of State for Defense Wes Streeting.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: ASW(ND-CBD) Dr. Robert Kadlec and NNSA Administrator visited NATO Headquarters and Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe
item.description: Robert Kadlec, U.S. assistant secretary of war for nuclear, chemical, and biological defense programs, and Brandon Williams, administrator of the National Nuclear Security Administration, met with NATO leaders to discuss deterrence and defense.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Certifies Production Capacity for Second Guided-Missile Destroyer at Maine's Bath Iron Works
item.description: Following a comprehensive, multiphase due diligence review, the War Department determined significant operational and managerial improvements at General Dynamics Bath Iron Works established the capacity and stability necessary to support the potential construction of a second guided-missile destroye
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Awards $6.3 Billion Multi-Year Contract to RTX's Raytheon for SM-3 BLOCK IB Interceptors
item.description: The War Department and the Missile Defense Agency awarded Raytheon, an RTX business, a multiyear procurement contract valued at up to $6.3 billion to produce Standard Missile–3 Block IB interceptors.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Announces $350 Million in Quantum Computing Initiatives
item.description: The Office of the Undersecretary of War for Research and Engineering announced new initiatives and programmatic updates totaling approximately $350 million to strengthen U.S. leadership in quantum computing capabilities that support national security.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $150 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With PsiQuantum
item.description: DOW's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment to PsiQuantum Corp. to enhance the company’s advanced manufacturing and prototyping capabilities in the United States.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War Executes White House Strategy for a New Golden Age of Science
item.description: The War Department announced a series of initiatives to advance President Donald J. Trump's vision for a New Golden Age of American science.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Announces $1.5 Billion Conditional Loan Commitment to Wolfspeed, Inc.
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $1.5 billion conditional loan commitment to a vertically integrated U.S. manufacturer of semiconductor materials.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Systems Selected for JIATF 401 Directed-Energy Counter-Drone Pilot Program
item.description: The War Department announced the directed-energy systems selected following the Joint Interagency Task Force 401's counter-unmanned aircraft systems-directed energy pilot program, marking the next phase of efforts to expand the operational use of high-energy laser and high-powered microwave capabili
item.dc:creator: Press Operations
